sentences.text: Valavia Oy is a company registered on 2023-11-24 under the industry code 71121, engineering design and technical consultancy.
First sales are recorded on 2023-11-24, a share issue was registered on 2026-09-22, and a first hire is recorded on 2026-08-24.
The register also shows a start-up notification dated 2023-11-27 and board changes dated 2025-10-03 and 2026-03-11.
No grant, EU project, public contract or funding record is on file, so only the first business level is read.
For the fund this is a watchlist case: the record shows an engineering consultancy and nothing about an ocean use.
